headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Exchange Hands
war_summary: By day 457 the conflict has sharpened on a half‑dozen corridors since the last edition three hours ago. Weathered Expanse now leads the butcher’s bill with 12,291 Colonial and 18,183 Warden dead in the past 24 hours and 39 ownership changes, the most recent only minutes old. Stlican Shelf follows with 3,293 Colonial and 4,099 Warden losses amid 28 base swaps. Nevish Line records 5,662 Colonial and 5,214 Warden casualties over 20 changes, while Palantine Berm adds 494 Colonial and 457 Warden dead with 12 flips. Stonecradle reports 5,559 Colonial and 7,912 Warden dead across 12 exchanges, and Callahans Passage tallies 9,811 Colonial and 10,876 Warden losses with seven movements. Linn Mercy has risen to 2,313 Colonial and 6,710 Warden dead with five changes, and Kuura Strand shows a modest 34 Colonial and 62 Warden casualties over four events. Hourly casualty trends are accelerating on all of these fronts and fresh enlistments are climbing sharply, signalling sustained manpower commitment. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
